title.en: Fable 6 — The Fisherman and the Little Fish

sentences.en: A fisherman caught a small fish.
She said to him: I am small, put me back.
I will grow and you will catch me again.

sentences.ar: قال الصياد: ما بترك اللي بإيدي.
sentences.en: The fisherman said: I do not leave what is in my hand.
And I do not know about tomorrow.
A bird in the hand is better than ten on the tree.
